title: Data Scientist
sdg_rationale: Turns data into evidence that drives research and innovation (SDG target 9.5: enhance scientific research and technological capability).
description: Builds models and analyses that answer business questions with data.

title: Statistician / Data Analyst
sdg_rationale: Produces the high-quality, timely and reliable data that SDG target 17.18 calls for.
description: Designs studies and analyses data to measure what is really happening.

title: Software Developer
sdg_rationale: Builds the software that upgrades the technological capability of industries (SDG target 9.5).
description: Designs and builds software applications and systems.

title: Web Developer
sdg_rationale: Expands access to online services and information (SDG target 9.c: universal and affordable access to ICT).
description: Builds and maintains websites and web apps.

title: UX / UI Designer
sdg_rationale: Accessible, inclusive design lets more people use digital services regardless of age or disability (SDG target 10.2: inclusion of all).
description: Designs how people use digital products.

title: Cybersecurity Analyst
sdg_rationale: Protects people and institutions from cybercrime and fraud (SDG target 16.4: combat all forms of organised crime).
description: Protects systems and data from attacks.

title: Cloud & Systems Administrator
sdg_rationale: Keeps the digital infrastructure that services depend on reliable and resilient (SDG target 9.1).
description: Runs and secures servers and networks and cloud platforms.

title: Systems / Business Analyst
sdg_rationale: Raises productivity by redesigning processes and systems (SDG target 8.2: productivity through technological upgrading and innovation).
description: Connects business needs to technology solutions.

title: Data Architect
sdg_rationale: Designs the reliable data infrastructure that organisations and public services rely on (SDG target 9.1).
description: Designs how an organisation's data is stored and connected.

title: QA / Test Engineer
onet_title: Software Quality Assurance Analysts and Testers
sdg_rationale: Makes the software people depend on safer and more reliable (SDG target 9.1: quality, reliable infrastructure).
description: Tests software and automates quality checks.

title: AI / ML Research Scientist
sdg_rationale: Advances scientific research and technological capability (SDG target 9.5).
description: Invents and improves AI and computing methods.

title: IT / Technology Manager
sdg_rationale: Leads digital teams that raise productivity through technology (SDG target 8.2).
description: Plans and leads technology teams and projects.

title: Management / Process Consultant
sdg_rationale: Helps organisations become more productive and use resources better (SDG target 8.2).
description: Analyses how organisations work and recommends improvements.

title: Electrical / Energy Engineer
sdg_rationale: Builds the power systems that raise the share of renewable energy (SDG target 7.2).
description: Designs electrical and power systems including renewables.

title: Environmental / Sustainability Specialist
onet_title: Environmental Scientists and Specialists, Including Health
sdg_rationale: Measures environmental impact and builds climate action into plans and decisions (SDG target 13.2).
description: Assesses environmental impact and designs ways to reduce it.

title: Digital Marketing Analyst
onet_title: Market Research Analysts and Marketing Specialists
sdg_rationale: Helps small and growing businesses find customers and grow (SDG target 8.3: support productive activities and SME growth).
description: Uses data to understand customers and campaigns.

title: Technical Writer
sdg_rationale: Makes technical knowledge accessible so more people gain skills for decent jobs (SDG target 4.4).
description: Writes clear documentation and guides.
